title: HT Highlighter — Email Draft
description: Draft-only outreach. needs_human short-circuits drafting (e.g. DNC or too little grounding). Every personalization claim in the body must be listed in cited_facts.

needs_human.description: true if the system refuses to auto-draft (DNC/active deal, or grounding too thin). When true, subject/body stay null and reason explains.

reason.description: Why a human is needed. Required (non-null) when needs_human is true.

body.description: Short outreach email (under ~120 words), one CTA. Draft-only — never sent automatically.

cited_facts.description: Every personalization claim used in the body, each mapped to the signal source it came from. Empty array is allowed only when needs_human is true.

source.description: Must match a signal's source/source_url from the brief.
